label: ASPSCR1::TFE3

sections.text: ASPSCR1 encodes a trafficking protein involved in intracellular GLUT4 transport.
TFE3 encodes a MiT/TFE-family transcription factor that regulates lysosomal and metabolic programs.

The fusion joins ASPSCR1 sequences to the TFE3 transcription-factor region, generating an abnormal transcriptional activator. It is characteristic of alveolar soft part sarcoma and also occurs in TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma.
Atezolizumab is US-approved for unresectable or metastatic alveolar soft part sarcoma from age 2 years. This histology-specific indication does not extend to TFE3-rearranged renal carcinoma.
